author: ques
body:
- EmeraldSword85, SomeonedoesMC, _quesadillas_, FrostedCupcakez

I'm making this report to help make sure that this glitch will be fixed, and also to report the players who I have pictures of, abusing this glitch after being told not to by 2 Senior Moderators.

Yesterday I was on Teamspeak and SomeonedoesMC and EmeraldSword85 were using the glitch in a game and telling me to come see what they were doing. I did, thinking nothing of it at the time. After a few rounds they found out that they could change the spectator spawn point. They did this until NolanDalton joined the channel and asked Emerald how the glitch worked. After Emerald explained, Nolan told them not to do the glitch anymore being that it broke the rules. Yet we continued once Nolan left. After changing a couple more spectator spawn points I stopped abusing the glitch because it got boring and we were told not to. They continued until itzdylan115 came into the game and told us to tell them to stop abusing the glitch. Yet they persisted.

Which brings me to today. Today in a match of Decay, SomeonedoesMC was doing the glitch. I asked Frosted to tell her to stop, knowing she was in a call with her. She told me to stop "commanding her" I told her that I was simply asking her to stop to prevent this online report from happening. She responded by changing the sign in the spectator spawn point to "Decay by _quesadillas_"  which made me a little heated, but I wanted them stop doing it as it was getting annoying. I feel like some new decisions regarding punishment towards abusing glitches need to be made.

I thank you for reading this report and I hope you find a rational and just way of handling this situation.


Screenshots:
http://imgur.com/a/zaIsm
